query: Oh hey, I just had the best iced matcha latte from the new café down my street this afternoon, they added a little extra vanilla syrup and it was so smooth I almost drank the whole thing in two sips. Also my cat just figured out how to open the snack cabinet last night, I caught her sitting on the counter gnawing on a pack of tuna treats like she owned the place. Oh and I binged the first three episodes of that new fantasy series everyone’s talking about last night, the costume design is insane I can’t stop thinking about the lead character’s embroidered cloak. Anyway, I need to cancel two of my pending orders please, the first one is order #W3289292 and the reason is I no longer need it, the second one is order #W9722559 and the cancellation reason is also no longer needed.
